```go
// pfRunner answers "<tool> --version" from versions, keyed by the tool's
// path; any other program fails.
type pfRunner struct{ versions map[string]string }

func (r pfRunner) Run(_ context.Context, cmd core.Cmd) (core.CmdResult, error) {
	v, ok := r.versions[cmd.Path]
	if !ok || len(cmd.Args) != 1 || cmd.Args[0] != "--version" {
		return core.CmdResult{}, fmt.Errorf("pf: run %s %v: %w", cmd.Path, cmd.Args, fs.ErrNotExist)
	}
	return core.CmdResult{Stdout: []byte(v + "\n")}, nil
}

const pfStatus = "Package: iptables\nStatus: install ok installed\nVersion: 1.8.10-3ubuntu2\n\n" +
	"Package: ufw\nStatus: install ok installed\nPriority: optional\nDescription: program for managing a Netfilter firewall\n" +
	" UFW is a front end.\nVersion: %s\n\nPackage: zsh\nStatus: install ok installed\nVersion: 5.9-6\n"

// pfHost writes a host whose UFW and nft tools of both families are
// present, with ufw version, and returns its root.
func pfHost(t *testing.T, version string) string {
	t.Helper()

	for _, p := range []string{"/usr/sbin/ufw", "/usr/sbin/iptables", "/usr/sbin/ip6tables",
		"/usr/sbin/iptables-nft-save", "/usr/sbin/iptables-nft-restore",
		"/usr/sbin/ip6tables-nft-save", "/usr/sbin/ip6tables-nft-restore"} {
		pfWrite(t, root, p, "#!/bin/sh\n")
	}
	pfWrite(t, root, "/var/lib/dpkg/status", fmt.Sprintf(pfStatus, version))
	return root
}

func pfWrite(t *testing.T, root, p, data string) {
	t.Helper()
	full := filepath.Join(root, p)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0o750); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(full, []byte(data), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

var pfNFT = map[string]string{"/usr/sbin/iptables": "iptables v1.8.10 (nf_tables)", "/usr/sbin/ip6tables": "ip6tables v1.8.10 (nf_tables)"}

// pfRun runs every preflight check of a fw rooted at root in order and
// returns the first failure's id and reason, as the agent reports it.
func pfRun(t *testing.T, root string, versions map[string]string) (string, error) {
	t.Helper()
	f := fw{d: deps{root: root}}
	env := core.Env{Exec: pfRunner{versions: versions}}
	checks := f.preflight()
	if len(checks) != 3 {

}

// TestUpstreamAtLeast compares the upstream part of Debian versions.
func TestUpstreamAtLeast(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		version string
		ok      bool
	}{
		{"0.35", true}, {"0.35.0", true}, {"0.36.1-4ubuntu0.1", true}, {"2:0.36", true}, {"1.0", true},
		{"0.34.9", false}, {"0.3.5", false}, {"0.34-1", false},
	} {
		ok, err := upstreamAtLeast(c.version, []int{0, 35})
		if err != nil || ok != c.ok {
			t.Errorf("upstreamAtLeast(%q) = %v, %v; want %v", c.version, ok, err, c.ok)
		}
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"", "-1", "x.35", "0..35"} {
		if _, err := upstreamAtLeast(bad, []int{0, 35}); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("upstreamAtLeast(%q) is no error", bad)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package firewall

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
)

// dpkgStatus is dpkg's database of installed packages. "ufw version" is not
// on the exec allowlist, so UFW's version comes from here.
const dpkgStatus = "/var/lib/dpkg/status"

// minUFW is the oldest UFW Darkpanel supports: rule comments, which carry
// Darkpanel's tags, need 0.35.
var minUFW = []int{0, 35}

// preflight is the firewall's preflight (spec 2): UFW is installed at
// version 0.35 or later, and the save and restore tools of the iptables
// variant each family uses exist. ip6tables is optional.
func (f fw) preflight() []core.PreflightCheck {
	return []core.PreflightCheck{
		{ID: "ufw", Run: f.checkUFW},
		{ID: "ufw-version", Run: f.checkUFWVersion},
		{ID: "iptables-tools", Run: f.checkTools},
	}
}

// hostPath is p under the module's root.
func (f fw) hostPath(p string) string { return filepath.Join(f.d.root, p) }

// regular fails unless p (under the root) is a regular file.
func (f fw) regular(p string) error {
	fi, err := os.Stat(f.hostPath(p))
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
		return missingFile(p)
	case err != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", p, err)
	case !fi.Mode().IsRegular():
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a regular file", p)
	}
	return nil
}

func (f fw) checkUFW(context.Context, core.Env) error {
	if err := f.regular(ufwPath); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("install UFW: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (f fw) checkUFWVersion(context.Context, core.Env) error {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(f.hostPath(dpkgStatus))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cannot read UFW's version from %s: %w", dpkgStatus, err)
	}
	version, ok := installedVersion(data, "ufw")
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("the ufw package is not installed according to %s", dpkgStatus)
	}
	atLeast, err := upstreamAtLeast(version, minUFW)
	switch {
	case err != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("cannot read UFW's version %q: %w", version, err)
	case !atLeast:
		return fmt.Errorf("UFW %s is older than 0.35, which Darkpanel needs for rule comments", version)
	}
	return nil
}

// installedVersion returns the Version of package pkg in a dpkg status
// database when its Status says it is installed.
func installedVersion(data []byte, pkg string) (string, bool) {
	for _, para := range bytes.Split(data, []byte("\n\n")) {
		fields := map[string]string{}
		sc := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(para))
		sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64<<10), 1<<20)
		for sc.Scan() {
			line := sc.Text()
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, " ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "\t") {
				continue
			}
			if k, v, ok := strings.Cut(line, ":"); ok {
				fields[k] = strings.TrimSpace(v)
			}
		}
		if fields["Package"] == pkg {
			return fields["Version"], strings.HasSuffix(fields["Status"], " installed") && fields["Version"] != ""
		}
	}
	return "", false
}

// upstreamAtLeast reports whether the upstream part of a Debian version
// (without the epoch and the Debian revision) is at least want, comparing
// dot-separated numbers.
func upstreamAtLeast(version string, want []int) (bool, error) {
	v := version
	if _, rest, ok := strings.Cut(v, ":"); ok {
		v = rest
	}
	if i := strings.LastIndex(v, "-"); i >= 0 {
		v = v[:i]
	}
	if v == "" {
		return false, errors.New("no upstream version")
	}
	var got []int
	for _, part := range strings.Split(v, ".") {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(part)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("%q is not a number", part)
		}
		got = append(got, n)
	}
	for i := 0; i < max(len(got), len(want)); i++ {
		var g, w int
		if i < len(got) {
			g = got[i]
		}
		if i < len(want) {
			w = want[i]
		}
		if g != w {
			return g > w, nil
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (f fw) checkTools(ctx context.Context, env core.Env) error {
	for _, tool := range []string{"iptables", "ip6tables"} {
		path := "/usr/sbin/" + tool
		if err := f.regular(path); err != nil {
			var missing missingFile
			if tool == "ip6tables" && errors.As(err, &missing) {
				continue
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("install iptables: %w", err)
		}
		res, err := env.Exec.Run(ctx, core.Cmd{Path: path, Args: []string{"--version"}})
		switch {
		case err != nil:
			return fmt.Errorf("%s --version: %w", path, err)
		case res.ExitCode != 0:
			return fmt.Errorf("%s --version exited %d", path, res.ExitCode)
		}
		line, _, _ := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(string(res.Stdout)), "\n")
		var variant string
		switch {
		case strings.HasSuffix(line, " (nf_tables)"):
			variant = "nft"
		case strings.HasSuffix(line, " (legacy)"):
			variant = "legacy"
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("cannot tell the variant of %s from %q", path, line)
		}
		for _, verb := range []string{"save", "restore"} {
			if err := f.regular(path + "-" + variant + "-" + verb); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("install iptables: %w", err)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// missingFile is regular's error for a path that does not exist.
type missingFile string

func (m missingFile) Error() string { return string(m) + " is missing" }
```

```go
package firewall

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/loaded"
)

// syLoaded parses one filter table, given as -A lines after the chain
// declarations, for both families.
func syLoaded(t *testing.T, decls string, rules ...string) fwstate.Loaded {
	t.Helper()
	text := "*filter\n" + decls + strings.Join(rules, "\n") + "\nCOMMIT\n"
	return fwstate.Loaded{Variant: "nft", V4: fhParse(t, text), V6: fhParse(t, text)}
}

const syDecls = ":INPUT DROP [0:0]\n:FORWARD DROP [0:0]\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:ufw-user-input - [0:0]\n:fw-foreign - [0:0]\n"

// TestSyncDiffs: an enabled UFW is compared with a reload's prediction over
// UFW's and Darkpanel's chains and the filter built-ins; a disabled one with
// a stop's over UFW's chains only, so a built-in policy set while UFW is off
// does not count.
func TestSyncDiffs(t *testing.T) {
	cur := syLoaded(t, syDecls, "-A INPUT -j ufw-user-input", "-A ufw-user-input -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT")
	pred := syLoaded(t, strings.Replace(syDecls, ":INPUT DROP", ":INPUT ACCEPT", 1),
		"-A INPUT -j ufw-user-input", "-A ufw-user-input -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT",
		"-A fw-foreign -j DROP")
	var trs []fwstate.Transition
	f := fw{d: deps{
		predict: func(_ fwstate.Config, c fwstate.Loaded, tr fwstate.Transition) (fwstate.Loaded, error) {
			if c.V4 != cur.V4 {
				t.Error("predict is not given the loaded state")
			}
			trs = append(trs, tr)
			return pred, nil
		},
		compare: loaded.Compare,
	}}

	diffs, err := f.syncDiffs(fwstate.Config{Enabled: true}, cur)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got []string
	for _, d := range diffs {
		got = append(got, chainDiffText(d))
	}
	want := []string{
		"v4 filter/INPUT: policy ACCEPT predicted, DROP loaded",
		"v4 filter/ufw-user-input: 1 rule only predicted, 1 only loaded",
		"v6 filter/INPUT: policy ACCEPT predicted, DROP loaded",
		"v6 filter/ufw-user-input: 1 rule only predicted, 1 only loaded",
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("enabled diffs\n%q\nwant\n%q", got, want)
	}

	diffs, err = f.syncDiffs(fwstate.Config{Enabled: false}, cur)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got = nil
	for _, d := range diffs {
		got = append(got, string(d.Family)+" "+d.Chain)
	}
	if want := []string{"v4 ufw-user-input", "v6 ufw-user-input"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("disabled diffs %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if want := []fwstate.Transition{fwstate.TransReload, fwstate.TransDisable}; !reflect.DeepEqual(trs, want) {
		t.Errorf("transitions %v, want %v", trs, want)
	}

	f.d.predict = func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded, fwstate.Transition) (fwstate.Loaded, error) {
		return fwstate.Loaded{}, errors.New("predict: translate: /etc/ufw/user.rules is empty")
	}
	if _, err := f.syncDiffs(fwstate.Config{Enabled: true}, cur); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "user.rules is empty") {
		t.Errorf("syncDiffs = %v, want the prediction's error", err)
	}
}

// TestConfined: a difference is confined to UFW's and Darkpanel's chains
// when it lies in such a chain, or in a filter built-in chain whose other
// rules are the same in order; a foreign chain, a foreign rule of a
// built-in chain, or a built-in chain of another table is not.
func TestConfined(t *testing.T) {
	base := []string{"-A INPUT -s 198.51.100.7/32 -j DROP", "-A INPUT -j ufw-user-input", "-A ufw-user-input -j ACCEPT"}
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		cur   []string
		decls string
		ok    bool
	}{
		{"in sync", base, syDecls, true},
		{"ufw chain", []string{base[0], base[1]}, syDecls, true},
		{"jump moved", []string{base[1], base[0], base[2]}, syDecls, true},
		{"jump missing and policy", []string{base[0], base[2]}, strings.Replace(syDecls, ":INPUT DROP", ":INPUT ACCEPT", 1), true},
		{"foreign rule added", append([]string{"-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9000 -j ACCEPT"}, base...), syDecls, false},
		{"foreign rule removed", base[1:], syDecls, false},
		{"foreign chain", append(append([]string(nil), base...), "-A fw-foreign -j DROP"), syDecls, false},
	}
	pred := syLoaded(t, syDecls, base...)
	for _, c := range cases {
		cur := syLoaded(t, c.decls, c.cur...)
		diffs := loaded.Compare(pred, cur, nil)
		if got := confined(diffs, pred, cur); got != c.ok {
			t.Errorf("%s: confined = %v, want %v (diffs %+v)", c.name, got, c.ok, diffs)
		}
	}
	natPred := fwstate.Loaded{V4: fhParse(t, "*nat\n:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]\nCOMMIT\n")}
	natCur := fwstate.Loaded{V4: fhParse(t, "*nat\n:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]\n-A POSTROUTING -j MASQUERADE\nCOMMIT\n")}
	if confined(loaded.Compare(natPred, natCur, nil), natPred, natCur) {
		t.Error("a nat built-in chain counts as UFW's")
	}
}

// TestChainDifferences: the JSON form keeps every field of a ChainDiff.
func TestChainDifferences(t *testing.T) {
	got := chainDifferences([]fwstate.ChainDiff{{Family: fwstate.V6, Table: "filter", Chain: "INPUT", PolicyA: "DROP", PolicyB: "ACCEPT",
		OnlyA: []string{"-j ufw6-before-input"}, OnlyB: []string{"-j ACCEPT"}, OrderDiffers: true}})
	want := []ChainDifference{{Family: "v6", Table: "filter", Chain: "INPUT", PolicyPredicted: "DROP", PolicyLoaded: "ACCEPT",
		OnlyPredicted: []string{"-j ufw6-before-input"}, OnlyLoaded: []string{"-j ACCEPT"}, OrderDiffers: true}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("chainDifferences = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
	if chainDifferences(nil) == nil {
		t.Error("chainDifferences(nil) is nil, want an empty list for JSON")
	}
	if s := chainDiffText(fwstate.ChainDiff{Family: fwstate.V4, Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", OnlyA: []string{"a", "b"}, OrderDiffers: true}); s != "v4 filter/ufw-user-input: 2 rules only predicted, order differs" {
		t.Errorf("chainDiffText = %q", s)
	}
}
```

```go
package firewall

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/fwstate"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/platform/netfilter"
)

// ChainDifference is one chain whose loaded rules differ from what UFW's
// configuration predicts (spec 2.3, in sync): the JSON form of a
// fwstate.ChainDiff, with the prediction on one side and the loaded state on
// the other. Rules are netfilter keys.
type ChainDifference struct {
	Family          string   `json:"family"` // v4 or v6
	Table           string   `json:"table"`
	Chain           string   `json:"chain"`
	PolicyPredicted string   `json:"policyPredicted,omitempty"` // set only when the built-in policies differ
	PolicyLoaded    string   `json:"policyLoaded,omitempty"`
	OnlyPredicted   []string `json:"onlyPredicted,omitempty"`
	OnlyLoaded      []string `json:"onlyLoaded,omitempty"`
	OrderDiffers    bool     `json:"orderDiffers,omitempty"`
}

// chainDifferences is the JSON form of diffs; never nil.
func chainDifferences(diffs []fwstate.ChainDiff) []ChainDifference {
	out := make([]ChainDifference, 0, len(diffs))
	for _, d := range diffs {
		out = append(out, ChainDifference{
			Family: string(d.Family), Table: d.Table, Chain: d.Chain, PolicyPredicted: d.PolicyA, PolicyLoaded: d.PolicyB,
			OnlyPredicted: d.OnlyA, OnlyLoaded: d.OnlyB, OrderDiffers: d.OrderDiffers,
		})
	}
	return out
}

// chainDiffText describes one difference on one line, for plans and
// errors.
func chainDiffText(d fwstate.ChainDiff) string {
	var parts []string
	if d.PolicyA != "" || d.PolicyB != "" {
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("policy %s predicted, %s loaded", d.PolicyA, d.PolicyB))
	}
	switch {
	case len(d.OnlyA) > 0 && len(d.OnlyB) > 0:
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s only predicted, %d only loaded", plural(len(d.OnlyA), "rule"), len(d.OnlyB)))
	case len(d.OnlyA) > 0:
		parts = append(parts, plural(len(d.OnlyA), "rule")+" only predicted")
	case len(d.OnlyB) > 0:
		parts = append(parts, plural(len(d.OnlyB), "rule")+" only loaded")
	}
	if d.OrderDiffers {
		parts = append(parts, "order differs")
	}
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		parts = append(parts, "present on one side only")
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s %s/%s: %s", d.Family, d.Table, d.Chain, strings.Join(parts, ", "))
}

func plural(n int, noun string) string {
	if n == 1 {
		return "1 " + noun
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d %ss", n, noun)
}

// ufwChain selects UFW's own chains.
func ufwChain(_ fwstate.Family, _, chain string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(chain, "ufw-") || strings.HasPrefix(chain, "ufw6-")
}

// syncDiffs compares the loaded state cur with what the configuration cfg
// predicts it to be (spec 2.3, in sync). An enabled UFW is compared with
// the result of a reload, over UFW's and Darkpanel's chains and the filter
// table's built-in chains, where UFW hooks in (rules a before.rules block
// adds to another table's built-in chains repeat on every start and are
// not compared). A disabled UFW is compared with the result of a stop, over
// UFW's chains only, so a built-in policy set while UFW is off does not
// count. A difference marks the host out of sync; after an apply, it fails
// verify.
func (f fw) syncDiffs(cfg fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded) ([]fwstate.ChainDiff, error) {
	tr, keep := fwstate.TransReload, restoreKeep
	if !cfg.Enabled {
		tr, keep = fwstate.TransDisable, ufwChain
	}
	pred, err := f.d.predict(cfg, cur, tr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict the loaded state of the configuration: %w", err)
	}
	return f.d.compare(pred, cur, keep), nil
}

// confined reports whether every difference between the prediction pred
// and the loaded state cur lies in UFW's and Darkpanel's own chains, which
// a repair may bring back (spec 2.3): a UFW or Darkpanel chain, or a
// built-in chain of the filter table whose rules other than jumps to such
// chains are the same, in order, on both sides (its policy and those jumps
// are UFW's). Any other difference is a foreign chain's.
func confined(diffs []fwstate.ChainDiff, pred, cur fwstate.Loaded) bool {
	for _, d := range diffs {
		switch {
		case firewallChain(d.Chain):
		case d.Table == "filter" && slices.Contains(builtinChains, d.Chain):
			a, b := familyRules(pred, d.Family), familyRules(cur, d.Family)
			if !slices.Equal(foreignKeys(a, d.Chain, d.Family), foreignKeys(b, d.Chain, d.Family)) {
				return false
			}
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func familyRules(st fwstate.Loaded, fam fwstate.Family) *netfilter.Ruleset {
	if fam == fwstate.V6 {
		return st.V6
	}
	return st.V4
}

// foreignKeys are the keys of a filter chain's rules that are not jumps to
// a UFW or Darkpanel chain.
func foreignKeys(rs *netfilter.Ruleset, chain string, fam fwstate.Family) []string {
	var out []string
	if c := chainOf(rs, "filter", chain); c != nil {
		for _, r := range c.Rules {
			if !firewallChain(r.Target.Name) {
				out = append(out, netfilter.Key(r, fam == fwstate.V6))
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

### Task 69: Report the firewall's status

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/modules/firewall/status.go`
- Test: `internal/modules/firewall/status_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `fw.syncDiffs`, `chainDifferences` (Task 68); `chainOf` and the test helpers `fakeHost`, `newFakeHost`, `fhParse`, `fhSave`, `fhTag` (part A1); `model.Merge`.
- Produces: `Status`, `Configured`, `Defaults`, `LoadedState`, `LoadedChain`, `ufwRunning`, `ufwNeverStarted`, `fw.status`, `loadedChains` (Part contracts, Task 69); test helper `suRuleRaw`.

**Depends on:** Task 68

**Implementer:** dforge:impl-sonnet-medium
**Evaluation:** files 1 - spec 0 - coupling 2 - risk 1 = 4

Resource `firewall.status` (spec 2.2) and its output types, which the web and CLI parts consume: the configured and loaded state, every rule from `model.Merge` with its origin (an unrepresentable manual rule read-only with its raw tuple), `active` (UFW's chains are loaded), `inSync` with the differing chains, and `supported` with the reasons. An unsupported host is not compared; a failed comparison is reported in `syncError`, not as an error. The tests run over part A1's fake host.

```go
// suRuleRaw is a manual rule the model cannot express (UFW keeps the IPv6
// host bits of 2001:db8::1/32).
const suRuleRaw = "### tuple ### deny any any ::/0 any 2001:db8::1/32 in"

func suStatus(t *testing.T, h *fakeHost) Status {
	t.Helper()
	f := fw{d: h.deps()}
	st, err := f.status(context.Background(), h.env())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return st
}

// TestStatus: the configured and loaded state, every rule with its origin
// (an unrepresentable manual rule read-only with its tuple), active, in
// sync and supported.
func TestStatus(t *testing.T) {
	h := newFakeHost(t)
	s := h.state()
	s.Rules6 = append(s.Rules6, suRuleRaw)
	h.setState(s)
	st := suStatus(t, h)

	if !st.Supported || len(st.Unsupported) != 0 || !st.Active || !st.InSync || len(st.OutOfSync) != 0 || st.SyncError != "" {
		t.Errorf("flags %+v, want supported, active and in sync", st)
	}
	wantCfg := Configured{Enabled: true, LogLevel: "low", IPv6: true, Defaults: Defaults{Incoming: "DROP", Outgoing: "ACCEPT", Routed: "DROP"},
		SysctlFile: "/etc/ufw/sysctl.conf"}
	if st.Configured != wantCfg {
		t.Errorf("configured %+v, want %+v", st.Configured, wantCfg)
	}
	if len(st.Rules) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("rules %+v, want 3", st.Rules)
	}
	if r := st.Rules[0]; r.ID != fhTag || r.Family != model.FamilyBoth || r.Origin != model.OriginDarkpanel || r.ToPort != "22" {
		t.Errorf("rule 1 %+v, want the both-family Darkpanel rule", r)
	}
	if r := st.Rules[1]; r.Origin != model.OriginManual || r.From != "10.0.0.0/8" || r.Raw != "" {
		t.Errorf("rule 2 %+v, want the IPv4 manual rule", r)
	}
	if r := st.Rules[2]; r.Origin != model.OriginManual || r.Raw != suRuleRaw {
		t.Errorf("rule 3 %+v, want the unrepresentable manual rule with its tuple", r)
	}

		t.Errorf("loaded %+v", st.Loaded)

		{Family: "v4", Table: "filter", Chain: "INPUT", Policy: "DROP", Rules: 1},
		{Family: "v4", Table: "filter", Chain: "FORWARD", Policy: "DROP", Rules: 0},
		{Family: "v4", Table: "filter", Chain: "OUTPUT", Policy: "ACCEPT", Rules: 0},
		{Family: "v4", Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", Rules: 1},
		{Family: "v6", Table: "filter", Chain: "INPUT", Policy: "DROP", Rules: 1},
		{Family: "v6", Table: "filter", Chain: "FORWARD", Policy: "DROP", Rules: 0},
		{Family: "v6", Table: "filter", Chain: "OUTPUT", Policy: "ACCEPT", Rules: 0},
		{Family: "v6", Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", Rules: 1},

	if !reflect.DeepEqual(st.Loaded.Chains, wantChains) {

// TestStatusOutOfSyncAndUnsupported: differing chains are listed; an
// unsupported host is not compared; a failed comparison is reported, not
// an error; an unreadable state is.
func TestStatusOutOfSyncAndUnsupported(t *testing.T) {
	h := newFakeHost(t)
	h.diffs = []fwstate.ChainDiff{{Family: fwstate.V4, Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", OnlyB: []string{"-p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT"}}}
	st := suStatus(t, h)
	want := []ChainDifference{{Family: "v4", Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", OnlyLoaded: []string{"-p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT"}}}
	if st.InSync || !reflect.DeepEqual(st.OutOfSync, want) {
		t.Errorf("in sync %v, out of sync %+v; want %+v", st.InSync, st.OutOfSync, want)
	}

	h = newFakeHost(t)
	h.loaded.Unsupported = []string{"iptables-legacy table filter chain INPUT holds 1 rule(s) outside the nft variant UFW uses"}
	h.writeFile("/etc/default/ufw", []byte(strings.Replace(string(h.state().files()["/etc/default/ufw"]), "MANAGE_BUILTINS=no", "MANAGE_BUILTINS=yes", 1)))
	st = suStatus(t, h)
	if st.Supported || st.InSync || len(h.keeps) != 0 || len(st.Unsupported) != 2 ||
		!strings.Contains(st.Unsupported[0], "MANAGE_BUILTINS") || !strings.Contains(st.Unsupported[1], "iptables-legacy") {
		t.Errorf("status %+v (compared %d times), want unsupported with the configuration's reason first, not compared", st, len(h.keeps))
	}

	h = newFakeHost(t)
	h.predictErr = errors.New("predict: translate: /etc/ufw/after.rules is empty")
	if st := suStatus(t, h); st.InSync || !strings.Contains(st.SyncError, "after.rules is empty") || !st.Supported {
		t.Errorf("status %+v, want not in sync with the prediction's error", st)
	}

	h = newFakeHost(t)
	h.loadErr = errors.New("loaded: /usr/sbin/iptables is not installed")
	if _, err := (fw{d: h.deps()}).status(context.Background(), h.env()); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not installed") {
		t.Errorf("status = %v, want the reader's error", err)
	}
}

// TestUFWChainsLoaded: UFW is running when its user chains are loaded, and
// never started when not even its primary chains are.
func TestUFWChainsLoaded(t *testing.T) {
	st := fwstate.Loaded{V4: fhParse(t, "*filter\n:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:ufw-before-logging-input - [0:0]\nCOMMIT\n")}
	if ufwRunning(st) || ufwNeverStarted(st) {
		t.Error("a stopped UFW reads as running or never started")
	}
	st.V4 = fhParse(t, fhSave)
	if !ufwRunning(st) || !ufwNeverStarted(st) {
		t.Error("the fake host's state: want running, with no primary chain")
	}
	if ufwRunning(fwstate.Loaded{}) || !ufwNeverStarted(fwstate.Loaded{}) {
		t.Error("no ruleset reads as running")
	}
}
```

```go
package firewall

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/fwstate"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/model"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/platform/netfilter"
)

// Status is the output of resource firewall.status (v1, spec 2.2): the
// configured and loaded state, every rule with its origin, and whether UFW
// is active, in sync and supported.
type Status struct {
	Supported   bool              `json:"supported"`
	Unsupported []string          `json:"unsupported"` // why the host is an unsupported configuration (spec 2.1); empty when supported
	Active      bool              `json:"active"`      // UFW's chains are loaded
	InSync      bool              `json:"inSync"`      // the loaded state is what the configuration predicts; false when unsupported
	OutOfSync   []ChainDifference `json:"outOfSync"`   // the chains that differ
	SyncError   string            `json:"syncError,omitempty"`
	Configured  Configured        `json:"configured"`
	Loaded      LoadedState       `json:"loaded"`
	// Rules are UFW's rules in its order (model.Merge): Darkpanel's carry
	// origin darkpanel, the others manual; a manual rule the model cannot
	// express carries only its id, origin and raw tuple, and is read-only.
	Rules []model.Rule `json:"rules"`
}

// Configured is UFW's configured state (spec 2.1).
type Configured struct {
	Enabled    bool     `json:"enabled"` // ENABLED=yes in ufw.conf
	LogLevel   string   `json:"logLevel"`
	IPv6       bool     `json:"ipv6"`
	Defaults   Defaults `json:"defaults"`
	SysctlFile string   `json:"sysctlFile,omitempty"` // IPT_SYSCTL
}

// Defaults are UFW's default policies, as /etc/default/ufw spells them
// (ACCEPT, DROP or REJECT).
type Defaults struct {
	Incoming string `json:"incoming"`
	Outgoing string `json:"outgoing"`
	Routed   string `json:"routed"`
}

// LoadedState is the loaded state (spec 2.1) in summary.
type LoadedState struct {
	Variant string            `json:"variant"` // nft or legacy
	IPv6    bool              `json:"ipv6"`    // ip6tables is present
	Sysctl  map[string]string `json:"sysctl"`  // the supported keys' live values
	Chains  []LoadedChain     `json:"chains"`
}

// LoadedChain is one loaded chain.
type LoadedChain struct {
	Family string `json:"family"`
	Table  string `json:"table"`
	Chain  string `json:"chain"`
	Policy string `json:"policy,omitempty"` // built-in chains only
	Rules  int    `json:"rules"`
}

// ufwRunning reports whether UFW's user chains are loaded: UFW is running.
func ufwRunning(st fwstate.Loaded) bool { return chainOf(st.V4, "filter", "ufw-user-input") != nil }

// ufwNeverStarted reports whether not even UFW's primary chains are loaded:
// UFW has not started since boot (a stop keeps them, empty).
func ufwNeverStarted(st fwstate.Loaded) bool {
	return chainOf(st.V4, "filter", "ufw-before-logging-input") == nil
}

// status reads resource firewall.status.
func (f fw) status(ctx context.Context, env core.Env) (Status, error) {
	cfg, err := f.d.readConfig(f.d.root)
	if err != nil {
		return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: status: %w", err)
	}
	cur, err := f.d.readLoaded(ctx, env)
	if err != nil {
		return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: status: %w", err)
	}
	st := Status{
		Unsupported: append(append([]string{}, cfg.Unsupported...), cur.Unsupported...),
		Active:      ufwRunning(cur),
		OutOfSync:   []ChainDifference{},
		Configured: Configured{
			Enabled: cfg.Enabled, LogLevel: cfg.LogLevel, IPv6: cfg.IPv6, SysctlFile: cfg.SysctlFile,
			Defaults: Defaults{Incoming: cfg.DefaultInput, Outgoing: cfg.DefaultOutput, Routed: cfg.DefaultForward},
		},
		Loaded: LoadedState{Variant: cur.Variant, IPv6: cur.V6 != nil, Sysctl: cur.Sysctl, Chains: loadedChains(cur)},
		Rules:  model.Merge(cfg.Rules4, cfg.Rules6),
	}
	if st.Rules == nil {
		st.Rules = []model.Rule{}
	}
	if st.Loaded.Sysctl == nil {
		st.Loaded.Sysctl = map[string]string{}
	}
	st.Supported = len(st.Unsupported) == 0
	if !st.Supported {
		return st, nil
	}
	diffs, err := f.syncDiffs(cfg, cur)
	if err != nil {
		st.SyncError = err.Error()
		return st, nil
	}
	st.InSync, st.OutOfSync = len(diffs) == 0, chainDifferences(diffs)
	return st, nil
}

// loadedChains lists every chain of both families in save order.
func loadedChains(st fwstate.Loaded) []LoadedChain {
	out := []LoadedChain{}
	for _, f := range []struct {
		fam fwstate.Family
		rs  *netfilter.Ruleset
	}{{fwstate.V4, st.V4}, {fwstate.V6, st.V6}} {
		if f.rs == nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, t := range f.rs.Tables {
			for _, c := range t.Chains {
				out = append(out, LoadedChain{Family: string(f.fam), Table: t.Name, Chain: c.Name, Policy: c.Policy, Rules: len(c.Rules)})
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
		t.Errorf("WriteSysctl accept_ra 2: %v", err)

		k, v := kv[0], kv[1]
		if err := files.WriteSysctl(ctx, ID, k, v); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "does not match") {
			t.Errorf("WriteSysctl(%s, %s) = %v, want a pattern refusal", k, v, err)
		}
	}

	u := &mfUnits{}
	scoped := platform.ScopeUnits(u, m)
	if _, err := scoped.State(ctx, "darkpanel-controller.service"); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("State of the controller unit: %v", err)
	}
	if err := scoped.Start(ctx, "darkpanel-controller.service"); err == nil {
		t.Error("Start of the controller unit is allowed")
	}
	if _, err := scoped.State(ctx, "darkpanel-agent.service"); err == nil {
		t.Error("State of the agent unit is allowed")
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(u.asked, []string{"darkpanel-controller.service"}) {
		t.Errorf("calls reaching the unit client %v, want the controller's state only", u.asked)
	}
}
```

```go
// Package firewall is the UFW firewall module (spec section 2): rules, safe
// apply, snapshots, the Docker integration and the exposure view.
package firewall

import (
	"io/fs"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/fwstate"
)

// ID is the module id.
const ID = "firewall"

// controllerUnit is the controller's unit, whose state tells the guard
// whether a controller runs on this host (owner ruling R3).
const controllerUnit = "darkpanel-controller.service"

// ufwSysctlFile is the only sysctl file UFW may apply that Darkpanel
// supports; snapshots restore it.
const ufwSysctlFile = "/etc/ufw/sysctl.conf"

// sysctlKeys are the supported sysctl keys of spec 2.1 with the values
// Darkpanel writes back; <iface> is all, default or an interface.
var sysctlKeys = []struct{ key, pattern string }{
	{"net/ipv4/ip_forward", "^[01]$"},
	{"net/ipv6/conf/<iface>/forwarding", "^[01]$"},
	{"net/ipv6/conf/<iface>/accept_ra", "^[012]$"},
	{"net/ipv4/conf/<iface>/rp_filter", "^[012]$"},
	{"net/ipv4/conf/<iface>/accept_source_route", "^[01]$"},
}

type module struct{ f fw }

// Module returns the firewall module over this host.
func Module() core.Module { return module{f: productionFW()} }

// Manifest declares the module. Every module is enabled by default;
// preflight decides whether it is available on a host (R9).
func (m module) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	return core.Manifest{
		ID:             ID,
		Version:        1,
		DefaultEnabled: true,
		Preflight:      m.f.preflight(),
		OwnedPaths:     ownedPaths(),
		Migrations:     map[core.Side]fs.FS{core.SideAgent: agentMigrations()},
		ExternalUnits:  []core.ExternalUnit{{Name: controllerUnit, Ops: []string{core.UnitOpState}}},
	}
}

// ownedPaths are the files a snapshot restores (kind restore: UFW's state
// files and its sysctl file, which uninstall never removes) and the sysctl
// keys a restore writes back.
func ownedPaths() []core.OwnedPath {
	var out []core.OwnedPath
	for _, p := range append(append([]string(nil), fwstate.StateFiles...), ufwSysctlFile) {
		out = append(out, core.OwnedPath{Path: p, Kind: core.OwnedRestore})
	}
	for _, k := range sysctlKeys {
		out = append(out, core.OwnedPath{Path: k.key, Kind: core.OwnedSysctl, Pattern: k.pattern})
	}
	return out
}
```

The prediction of spec 2.3 in part P's call order: each command edits the configuration; the transition (start, stop, reload or none) follows UFW's state before and after; the IPv6 refusal and `Predict` use the configuration before the transition's own command, whose edit gives the final configuration; and the sysctl prediction, with a restore's values over it. After `ufw --force enable` a reload follows when UFW never started (controller ruling: the first start loads the package's template files) or when UFW's chains are loaded already (ufw-init then loads nothing). The tests use a predictor that records each transition in the variant, so every path's history is visible.

```go
// recording every input and state; ipv6Refusal answers ipv6Err.
type fwStub struct {
	guard   core.Guard
	flows   []guard.FlowResult
	err     error
	inputs  []guard.Input
	states  []fwstate.Loaded
	ipv6Err error
}

// newFW is a fw over the fake host h with a passing stub guard.
func newFW(h *fakeHost) (fw, *fwStub) {
	s := &fwStub{guard: core.Guard{ID: guard.GuardID, OK: true, Message: "every protected flow passes (1 checked)"}}
	f := fw{
		d: h.deps(),
		ipv6Refusal: func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded, fwstate.Transition) error {
			return s.ipv6Err
		},
		check: func(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, st fwstate.Loaded, in guard.Input) (core.Guard, []guard.FlowResult, error) {
			s.inputs, s.states = append(s.inputs, in), append(s.states, st)
			if s.err != nil {
				return core.Guard{}, nil, s.err
			}
			g := s.guard
			if g.ID == "" {
				g.ID = guard.GuardID
			}
			return g, s.flows, nil
		},
	}
	return f, s
}

// started (no chain), stopped (primary chains left) and running.
const (
	tgNeverStarted = "*filter\n:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\nCOMMIT\n"
	tgStopped      = "*filter\n:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:ufw-before-logging-input - [0:0]\nCOMMIT\n"
	tgRunning      = "*filter\n:INPUT DROP [0:0]\n:FORWARD DROP [0:0]\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]\n:ufw-before-logging-input - [0:0]\n:ufw-user-input - [0:0]\nCOMMIT\n"
)

// tgHost is a fake host whose ufw edits the enabled state, the defaults
// and rules, and whose predictor appends each transition it predicts to
// the variant, so a prediction's history reads "nft|enable|reload".
type tgHost struct {
	*fakeHost
	f        fw
	stub     *fwStub
	ipv6Args []fwstate.Transition
	sysctlTr []fwstate.Transition
}

func newTGHost(t *testing.T, save string, enabled bool) *tgHost {
	t.Helper()
	h := &tgHost{fakeHost: newFakeHost(t)}
	s := h.state()
	s.Enabled = enabled
	h.setState(s)
	h.loaded = fwstate.Loaded{Variant: "nft", V4: fhParse(t, save), V6: fhParse(t, save)}
	h.ufw["--force enable"] = func(s *fhState) int { s.Enabled = true; return 0 }
	h.ufw["disable"] = func(s *fhState) int { s.Enabled = false; return 0 }
	h.ufw["reload"] = func(*fhState) int { return 0 }
	h.ufw["allow in proto tcp from any to any port 80 comment darkpanel:01J00000000000000000000002"] = func(s *fhState) int {
		s.Rules4 = append(s.Rules4, strings.Replace(fhRule22v4, "22", "80", 1))
		return 0
	}
	h.f, h.stub = newFW(h.fakeHost)
	h.f.d.predict = func(_ fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded, tr fwstate.Transition) (fwstate.Loaded, error) {
		cur.Variant += "|" + string(tr)
		return cur, nil
	}
	h.f.d.sysctl = func(_ fwstate.Config, cur map[string]string, tr fwstate.Transition) (map[string]string, error) {
		h.sysctlTr = append(h.sysctlTr, tr)
		out := maps.Clone(cur)
		out["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] = "1"
		return out, nil
	}
	h.f.ipv6Refusal = func(_ fwstate.Config, _ fwstate.Loaded, tr fwstate.Transition) error {
		h.ipv6Args = append(h.ipv6Args, tr)
		return h.stub.ipv6Err
	}
	return h
}

// cur is the loaded state as the host's reader returns it, with the live
// sysctl values.
func (h *tgHost) cur() fwstate.Loaded {
	st := h.loaded
	st.Sysctl = maps.Clone(h.sysctl)
	return st
}

func tgAllow80(t *testing.T) ufwOp {
	t.Helper()
	op, err := addRuleOp(model.Rule{ID: "01J00000000000000000000002", Action: model.ActionAllow, Direction: model.DirIn,
		Proto: model.ProtoTCP, From: model.Any, To: model.Any, ToPort: "80", Family: model.FamilyBoth})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return op
}

func tgCmds(cmds [][]string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, c := range cmds {
		out = append(out, strings.Join(c, " "))
	}
	return out
}

var yes, no = true, false

// TestTargetTransitions: the transition, the commands Apply runs after the
// change's own and the predicted loaded state, for each starting point.
func TestTargetTransitions(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		save    string
		enabled bool
		change  func(t *testing.T) change
		tr      fwstate.Transition
		cmds    []string
		history string
		final   bool
	}{
		{"rule on an active UFW", tgRunning, true, func(t *testing.T) change { return change{ops: []ufwOp{tgAllow80(t)}} },
			fwstate.TransReload, []string{"reload"}, "nft|reload", true},
		{"rule on an inactive UFW", tgStopped, false, func(t *testing.T) change { return change{ops: []ufwOp{tgAllow80(t)}} },
			fwstate.TransNone, nil, "nft|none", false},
		{"enable a stopped UFW", tgStopped, false, func(*testing.T) change { return change{enable: &yes} },
			fwstate.TransEnable, []string{"--force enable"}, "nft|enable", true},
		{"first enable", tgNeverStarted, false, func(*testing.T) change { return change{enable: &yes} },
			fwstate.TransEnable, []string{"--force enable", "reload"}, "nft|enable|reload", true},
		{"enable with UFW's chains loaded", tgRunning, false, func(*testing.T) change { return change{enable: &yes} },
			fwstate.TransEnable, []string{"--force enable", "reload"}, "nft|reload", true},
		{"enable an active UFW", tgRunning, true, func(*testing.T) change { return change{enable: &yes} },
			fwstate.TransNone, nil, "nft|none", true},
		{"disable", tgRunning, true, func(*testing.T) change { return change{enable: &no} },
			fwstate.TransDisable, []string{"disable"}, "nft|disable", false},
		{"repair an active UFW", tgRunning, true, func(*testing.T) change { return change{repair: true} },
			fwstate.TransReload, []string{"reload"}, "nft|reload", true},
		{"repair a running UFW configured off", tgRunning, false, func(*testing.T) change { return change{repair: true} },
			fwstate.TransDisable, []string{"disable"}, "nft|disable", false},
		{"repair a stopped UFW", tgStopped, false, func(*testing.T) change { return change{repair: true} },
			fwstate.TransNone, nil, "nft|none", false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newTGHost(t, c.save, c.enabled)
			cfg0 := h.config()
			tg, err := h.f.predictTarget(cfg0, h.cur(), c.change(t))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if tg.tr != c.tr || !reflect.DeepEqual(tgCmds(tg.cmds), c.cmds) || tg.pred.Variant != c.history || tg.final.Enabled != c.final {
				t.Errorf("target %s %q %s final enabled %v; want %s %q %s %v", tg.tr, tgCmds(tg.cmds), tg.pred.Variant, tg.final.Enabled,
					c.tr, c.cmds, c.history, c.final)
			}
			if tg.pred.Sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] != "1" || len(h.sysctlTr) != 1 || h.sysctlTr[0] != c.tr {
				t.Errorf("sysctl %v predicted for %v, want the sysctl prediction for %s", tg.pred.Sysctl, h.sysctlTr, c.tr)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestTargetCommands: the configuration after the change's commands holds
// their effect, and the IPv6 refusal is asked about the transition.
func TestTargetCommands(t *testing.T) {
	h := newTGHost(t, tgRunning, true)
	tg, err := h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{ops: []ufwOp{tgAllow80(t)}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(tg.cfgN.Rules4) != 3 || len(tg.final.Rules4) != 3 || !strings.Contains(tg.cfgN.Rules4[2].Raw, "allow tcp 80 ") {
		t.Errorf("rules after the change %+v, want the new rule appended", tg.cfgN.Rules4)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(h.ipv6Args, []fwstate.Transition{fwstate.TransReload}) {
		t.Errorf("IPv6 refusal asked for %v, want reload", h.ipv6Args)
	}

	h.stub.ipv6Err = errcode.New(errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration, "chain DOCKER-USER; set IPV6=yes in /etc/default/ufw")
	_, err = h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{ops: []ufwOp{tgAllow80(t)}})
	if errcode.From(err).Code != errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration {
		t.Errorf("predictTarget = %v, want the IPv6 refusal", err)
	}

	h = newTGHost(t, tgRunning, true)
	op := tgAllow80(t)
	op.Args = append([]string{"route"}, op.Args...)
	_, err = h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{ops: []ufwOp{op}})
	if e := errcode.From(err); e.Code != errcode.InvalidInput || !strings.Contains(e.Detail, "ufw route allow") {
		t.Errorf("predictTarget = %v, want an invalid input naming the command", err)
	}

	h = newTGHost(t, tgRunning, true)
	refusal := errcode.New(errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration, "/etc/ufw/sysctl.conf sets net/ipv4/ip_forward to \"2\"")
	h.f.d.sysctl = func(fwstate.Config, map[string]string, fwstate.Transition) (map[string]string, error) {
		return nil, refusal
	}
	if _, err := h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{repair: true}); !errors.Is(err, refusal) {
		t.Errorf("predictTarget = %v, want the sysctl refusal", err)
	}
	h = newTGHost(t, tgRunning, true)
	h.f.d.predict = func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded, fwstate.Transition) (fwstate.Loaded, error) {
		return fwstate.Loaded{}, errors.New("predict: translate: /etc/ufw/before.rules is empty")
	}
	if _, err := h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{repair: true}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "before.rules is empty") {
		t.Errorf("predictTarget = %v, want the prediction's error", err)
	}
}

// TestTargetRestore: a restore's configuration is the snapshot's, its
// transition follows the snapshot's and the current UFW state, and the
// snapshot's sysctl values overlay the prediction for the keys that exist.
func TestTargetRestore(t *testing.T) {
	h := newTGHost(t, tgStopped, false)
	s := h.state()
	s.Enabled, s.Rules4, s.Rules6, s.Input = true, []string{fhRule3000v4}, nil, "REJECT"
	snapCfg := h.config()
	var entries []core.RestoreEntry
	for p, data := range s.files() {
		e := snapCfg.Files[p]
		e.Data = data
		snapCfg.Files[p] = e
	}
	for _, p := range fwstate.StateFiles {
		entries = append(entries, snapCfg.Files[p])
	}
	snap := snapshot{ID: "01J00000000000000000000009", Entries: entries,
		State: snapshotState{Enabled: true, Sysctl: map[string]string{"net/ipv4/conf/eth0/rp_filter": "0", "net/ipv4/conf/eth9/rp_filter": "1"}}}

	tg, err := h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), h.cur(), change{restore: &snap})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tg.tr != fwstate.TransEnable || len(tg.cfgN.Rules4) != 1 || tg.cfgN.DefaultInput != "REJECT" || len(tg.cfgN.Rules6) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("target %s rules %d/%d input %s; want enable with the snapshot's configuration", tg.tr, len(tg.cfgN.Rules4), len(tg.cfgN.Rules6), tg.cfgN.DefaultInput)
	}
	if v, ok := tg.pred.Sysctl["net/ipv4/conf/eth9/rp_filter"]; ok || tg.pred.Sysctl["net/ipv4/conf/eth0/rp_filter"] != "0" || tg.pred.Sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] != "1" {
		t.Errorf("sysctl %v (eth9 %q), want the snapshot's eth0 value over the prediction and no gone interface", tg.pred.Sysctl, v)
	}

	h.f.d.sysctl = func(_ fwstate.Config, cur map[string]string, _ fwstate.Transition) (map[string]string, error) {
		return cur, nil
	}
	cur := h.cur()
	if _, err := h.f.predictTarget(h.config(), cur, change{restore: &snap}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cur.Sysctl["net/ipv4/conf/eth0/rp_filter"] != "1" {
		t.Error("the snapshot's sysctl values overwrote the loaded state's")
	}
}
```

```go
package firewall

import (
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/fwstate"
)

// change is what one mutating action asks of UFW, computed from its input
// and the configured state.
type change struct {
	ops     []ufwOp   // rule, default and logging commands, in order
	enable  *bool     // the UFW state the action sets; nil keeps it
	restore *snapshot // a snapshot whose files, UFW state and sysctl values the action brings back
	repair  bool      // from the actual loaded state to the target (spec 2.3, the repair path)
}

// target is where a change ends.
type target struct {
	cfgN  fwstate.Config     // after the change's own commands (a restore: the snapshot's configuration)
	final fwstate.Config     // after the transition commands too
	tr    fwstate.Transition // the transition the change causes
	cmds  [][]string         // the transition commands Apply runs after the change's own, in order
	pred  fwstate.Loaded     // the loaded state it predicts, with the sysctl values
}

// The transition commands.
var (
	enableArgs  = []string{"--force", "enable"}
	disableArgs = []string{"disable"}
	reloadArgs  = []string{"reload"}
)

// predictTarget predicts change c from the configuration cfg0 and the
// loaded state cur (spec 2.3), in the predictor's order: each command
// edits the configuration; then the IPv6 refusal and the prediction of the
// transition use the configuration from before the transition's own
// command, whose edit gives the final configuration. The transition
// follows UFW's state before and after: a start, a stop, a reload when the
// commands, a restore or a repair change an active UFW, or none. After
// "ufw --force enable", Apply also reloads when UFW never started (its
// first start loads the package's template files, which it rewrites only
// afterwards) and when UFW's chains are loaded already (ufw-init then loads
// nothing). The sysctl values are the prediction of UFW's sysctl file for
// the transition, with a restore's values over them for every key that
// still exists.
func (f fw) predictTarget(cfg0 fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded, c change) (target, error) {
	tg := target{cfgN: cfg0}
	for _, op := range c.ops {
		next, err := f.d.edit(tg.cfgN, op.Args)
		if err != nil {
			return target{}, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput,
				fmt.Sprintf("Darkpanel cannot predict ufw %s: %v", strings.Join(op.Args, " "), err))
		}
		tg.cfgN = next
	}
	want := tg.cfgN.Enabled
	var restored map[string]string
	if c.restore != nil {
		cfgS, err := f.snapshotConfig(*c.restore)
		if err != nil {
			return target{}, err
		}
		tg.cfgN, want, restored = cfgS, c.restore.State.Enabled, c.restore.State.Sysctl
	}
	if c.enable != nil {
		want = *c.enable
	}
	sysctlTr := fwstate.TransNone
	var err error
	switch running := ufwRunning(cur); {
	case want && !cfg0.Enabled:
		tg.tr, sysctlTr = fwstate.TransEnable, fwstate.TransEnable
		err = f.start(&tg, cur, running)
	case !want && (cfg0.Enabled || (c.repair && running)):
		tg.tr, sysctlTr = fwstate.TransDisable, fwstate.TransDisable
		err = f.transition(&tg, cur, fwstate.TransDisable, disableArgs)
	case want && (len(c.ops) > 0 || c.restore != nil || c.repair):
		tg.tr, sysctlTr = fwstate.TransReload, fwstate.TransReload
		err = f.transition(&tg, cur, fwstate.TransReload, reloadArgs)
	default:
		tg.tr, tg.final = fwstate.TransNone, tg.cfgN
		tg.pred, err = f.d.predict(tg.cfgN, cur, fwstate.TransNone)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return target{}, err
	}
	sysctl, err := f.d.sysctl(tg.final, cur.Sysctl, sysctlTr)
	if err != nil {
		return target{}, err
	}
	tg.pred.Sysctl = maps.Clone(sysctl)
	for k, v := range restored {
		if _, ok := tg.pred.Sysctl[k]; ok {
			tg.pred.Sysctl[k] = v
		}
	}
	return tg, nil
}

// transition predicts a reload or a stop: the IPv6 refusal, the predicted
// loaded state from the configuration before the command, and the command's
// edit.
func (f fw) transition(tg *target, cur fwstate.Loaded, tr fwstate.Transition, args []string) error {
	if err := f.ipv6Refusal(tg.cfgN, cur, tr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pred, err := f.d.predict(tg.cfgN, cur, tr)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict ufw %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), err)
	}
	final, err := f.edit(tg.cfgN, args)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tg.pred, tg.final, tg.cmds = pred, final, append(tg.cmds, args)
	return nil
}

// start predicts "ufw --force enable" and the reload that may follow it.
func (f fw) start(tg *target, cur fwstate.Loaded, running bool) error {
	enabled, err := f.edit(tg.cfgN, enableArgs)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if running {
		cfgN := tg.cfgN
		tg.cfgN = enabled
		err := f.transition(tg, cur, fwstate.TransReload, reloadArgs)
		tg.cfgN, tg.cmds = cfgN, append([][]string{enableArgs}, tg.cmds...)
		return err
	}
	if err := f.ipv6Refusal(tg.cfgN, cur, fwstate.TransEnable); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pred, err := f.d.predict(tg.cfgN, cur, fwstate.TransEnable)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict ufw --force enable: %w", err)
	}
	tg.pred, tg.final, tg.cmds = pred, enabled, [][]string{enableArgs}
	if !ufwNeverStarted(cur) {
		return nil
	}
	if tg.pred, err = f.d.predict(enabled, pred, fwstate.TransReload); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict ufw reload: %w", err)
	}
	if tg.final, err = f.edit(enabled, reloadArgs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tg.cmds = append(tg.cmds, reloadArgs)
	return nil
}

// edit predicts a transition command's edit of the configuration.
func (f fw) edit(cfg fwstate.Config, args []string) (fwstate.Config, error) {
	next, err := f.d.edit(cfg, args)
	if err != nil {
		return fwstate.Config{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict ufw %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), err)
	}
	return next, nil
}

// snapshotConfig reads a snapshot's configuration: its files, written
// under a temporary root, read as the host's are.
func (f fw) snapshotConfig(s snapshot) (fwstate.Config, error) {
	root, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dp-fw-snapshot")
	if err != nil {
		return fwstate.Config{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: snapshot %s: %w", s.ID, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(root) }()
	for _, e := range s.Entries {
		if !e.Present {
			continue
		}
		full := filepath.Join(root, e.Path)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0o700); err != nil {
			return fwstate.Config{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: snapshot %s: %w", s.ID, err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, e.Data, 0o600); err != nil {
			return fwstate.Config{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: snapshot %s: %w", s.ID, err)
		}
	}
	cfg, err := f.d.readConfig(root)
	if err != nil {
		return fwstate.Config{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: snapshot %s: %w", s.ID, err)
	}
	cfg.Files = maps.Clone(cfg.Files)
	for _, e := range s.Entries {
		cfg.Files[e.Path] = e
	}
	return cfg, nil
}
```

```go
package firewall

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"

)

// pnRule is the rule the plan tests add.
var pnRule = model.Rule{ID: planRuleID, Action: model.ActionAllow, Direction: model.DirIn, Proto: model.ProtoTCP,
	From: model.Any, To: model.Any, ToPort: "80", Family: model.FamilyBoth}

// pnHost is a fake host whose ufw adds pnRule.
func pnHost(t *testing.T) (*fakeHost, fw, *fwStub) {
	t.Helper()
	h := newFakeHost(t)
	h.ufw[strings.Join(model.AddArgs(pnRule), " ")] = func(s *fhState) int {
		s.Rules4 = append(s.Rules4, "### tuple ### allow tcp 80 0.0.0.0/0 any 0.0.0.0/0 in comment="+hex.EncodeToString([]byte(model.Tag(planRuleID, ""))))
		return 0
	}
	h.ufw["reload"] = func(*fhState) int { return 0 }
	f, stub := newFW(h)
	return h, f, stub
}

type pnInput struct {
	core.Guarded
	Port string `json:"port"`
}

func pnAddRule(t *testing.T) func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) {
	t.Helper()
	return func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) {
		op, err := addRuleOp(pnRule)
		return change{ops: []ufwOp{op}}, err
	}
}

func pnReq(t *testing.T, g core.Guarded) planReq {
	return planReq{input: pnInput{Guarded: g, Port: "80"}, guarded: g, build: pnAddRule(t)}
}

// TestPlanPasses: the plan shows the change, runs the lockout guard on the
// predicted state with the plan's and the apply's guard contexts and the
// real evaluator, and hashes the input and the state it read.
func TestPlanPasses(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, stub := pnHost(t)
	gc := &core.GuardContext{Complete: true, Client: &core.Peer{Port: 50000}}
	refresh := &core.GuardContext{Complete: true}
	env := h.env()
	env.Call = core.CallContext{GuardRefresh: refresh, Retired: []string{"exp1"}}
	out, err := f.plan(ctx, env, pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Guard: gc}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: "rule new: allow in proto tcp from 0.0.0.0/0 to 0.0.0.0/0 port 80"}}; !reflect.DeepEqual(out.Diff, want) {
		t.Errorf("diff %+v, want %+v", out.Diff, want)
	}
	if len(out.Guards) != 1 || !out.Guards[0].OK || out.Guards[0].ID != guard.GuardID || out.Guards[0].Overridden {
		t.Errorf("guards %+v, want one passing lockout guard", out.Guards)
	}
	if len(stub.inputs) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("guard checked %d times, want 1", len(stub.inputs))
	}
	in := stub.inputs[0]
	if in.Plan != gc || in.Refresh != refresh || !reflect.DeepEqual(in.Retired, []string{"exp1"}) {
		t.Errorf("guard input %+v, want the plan's guard, the apply's refresh and the retired exposures", in)
	}
	wrSameFunc(t, "Eval", in.Eval, eval.Evaluate)
	if stub.states[0].Sysctl == nil {
		t.Error("the guard ran on a state without sysctl values")
	}
	if out.StateHash == "" {
		t.Fatal("no state hash")
	}
	again, err := f.plan(ctx, env, pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Guard: gc}))
	if err != nil || again.StateHash != out.StateHash {
		t.Errorf("a second plan hashes %q (%v), want %q", again.StateHash, err, out.StateHash)
	}
	other, err := f.plan(ctx, env, planReq{input: pnInput{Port: "81"}, build: pnAddRule(t)})
	if err != nil || other.StateHash == out.StateHash {
		t.Errorf("another input hashes the same (%v)", err)
	}
	h.sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] = "1"
	if moved, err := f.plan(ctx, env, pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Guard: gc})); err != nil || moved.StateHash == out.StateHash {
		t.Errorf("a changed sysctl value hashes the same (%v)", err)
	}
	h.sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] = "0"
	h.loaded.V4 = fhParse(t, strings.Replace(fhSave, "--dport 22", "--dport 2222", 1))
	if moved, err := f.plan(ctx, env, pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Guard: gc})); err != nil || moved.StateHash == out.StateHash {
		t.Errorf("a changed loaded rule hashes the same (%v)", err)
	}
}

// TestPlanGuardOverrides: a failing guard fails the plan's guard; listed in
// overrides it passes as overridden with its message; a guard that cannot
// run fails the plan.
func TestPlanGuardOverrides(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, stub := pnHost(t)
	cut := "the change would cut ssh from 203.0.113.7 to 192.0.2.1:22 on eth0: drop (filter/INPUT policy DROP)"
	stub.guard = core.Guard{OK: false, Message: cut}
	out, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), pnReq(t, core.Guarded{}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if g := out.Guards[0]; g.OK || g.Overridden || g.Message != cut {
		t.Errorf("guard %+v, want failing with the flow", g)
	}
	out, err = f.plan(ctx, h.env(), pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if g := out.Guards[0]; !g.OK || !g.Overridden || g.Message != cut {
		t.Errorf("guard %+v, want overridden with the flow", g)
	}
	stub.err = errors.New("firewall: read the socket table: netstat: no socket tables under the proc root")
	if _, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}})); !errors.Is(err, stub.err) {
		t.Errorf("plan = %v, want the guard's error", err)
	}
}

// TestPlanRefusals: an unsupported configuration is refused whatever the
// action; a manual rule change needs manual: true.
func TestPlanRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, _ := pnHost(t)
	h.loaded.Unsupported = []string{"nft table inet dpforeign: base chain \"ruled\" on hook \"input\" has 2 rule(s) and policy accept"}
	_, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}}))
	if e := errcode.From(err); e.Code != errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration || !strings.Contains(e.Detail, "dpforeign") {
		t.Errorf("plan = %v, want an unsupported configuration naming the reason", err)
	}

	h, f, _ = pnHost(t)
	s := h.state()
	deleteManual := func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) {
		return change{ops: []ufwOp{{Kind: core.EffectDelete, Resource: ruleResource("manual"), Args: []string{"delete", "allow", "3000"}}}}, nil
	}
	h.ufw["delete allow 3000"] = func(s *fhState) int { s.Rules4 = s.Rules4[:1]; return 0 }
	_, err = f.plan(ctx, h.env(), planReq{input: 1, build: deleteManual})
	if e := errcode.From(err); e.Code != errcode.FirewallManualRequired || !strings.Contains(e.Detail, "manual-") {
		t.Errorf("plan = %v, want manual required naming the rule", err)
	}
	out, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), planReq{input: 1, manual: true, build: deleteManual})
	if err != nil || len(out.Diff) != 1 || !strings.Contains(out.Diff[0].Text, "(manual)") || out.Diff[0].Op != "-" {
		t.Errorf("plan = %+v, %v; want the manual rule's removal", out.Diff, err)
	}
	if h.state().Rules4[1] != s.Rules4[1] {
		t.Error("the plan changed the host")
	}

	h, f, _ = pnHost(t)
	boom := errors.New("firewall: rule 01J00000000000000000000009 not found")
	if _, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), planReq{input: 1, build: func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) { return change{}, boom }}); !errors.Is(err, boom) {
		t.Errorf("plan = %v, want the action's error", err)
	}
}

// TestPlanOutOfSync: an out-of-sync host shows the differing chains and
// fails the guard as a hard refusal that overrides cannot pass, except for
// a repair whose difference is confined to UFW's and Darkpanel's chains,
// whose guard runs as usual.
func TestPlanOutOfSync(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, stub := pnHost(t)
	h.diffs = []fwstate.ChainDiff{{Family: fwstate.V4, Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw-user-input", OnlyB: []string{"-p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT"}}}
	out, err := f.plan(ctx, h.env(), pnReq(t, core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	last := out.Diff[len(out.Diff)-1]
	if last.Op != " " || last.Text != "out of sync: v4 filter/ufw-user-input: 1 rule only loaded" {
		t.Errorf("diff %+v, want the differing chain last", out.Diff)
	}
	if g := out.Guards[0]; g.OK || g.Overridden || !strings.Contains(g.Message, "out of sync") || len(stub.inputs) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("guard %+v (checked %d times), want a hard refusal without a check", g, len(stub.inputs))
	}

	repair := planReq{input: 2, guarded: core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}},
		build: func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) { return change{repair: true}, nil }}
	stub.guard = core.Guard{OK: false, Message: "the change would cut agent link: drop"}
	out, err = f.plan(ctx, h.env(), repair)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if g := out.Guards[0]; !g.OK || !g.Overridden || len(stub.inputs) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("repair guard %+v (checked %d times), want the guard run and overridden", g, len(stub.inputs))
	}

	h.diffs = append(h.diffs, fwstate.ChainDiff{Family: fwstate.V4, Table: "filter", Chain: "fw-foreign", OnlyB: []string{"-j DROP"}})
	out, err = f.plan(ctx, h.env(), repair)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if g := out.Guards[0]; g.OK || g.Overridden || !strings.Contains(g.Message, "fw-foreign") || len(stub.inputs) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("repair guard %+v, want a hard refusal naming the foreign chain", g)
	}
}
```

```go
package firewall

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/eval"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/fwstate"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/modules/firewall/guard"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/platform/netfilter"
)

// buildFunc computes an action's change from its input and the current
// configured and loaded state.
type buildFunc func(cfg fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded) (change, error)

// planReq is one mutating action's plan request.
type planReq struct {
	input   any          // the action's decoded input, which the state hash covers
	guarded core.Guarded // the input's guard context and overrides
	manual  bool         // the input's manual: true
	build   buildFunc
}

// prepared is a change computed from the state it starts from.
type prepared struct {
	cfg0 fwstate.Config
	cur  fwstate.Loaded
	c    change
	tg   target
}

// prepare reads the configured and loaded state, refuses an unsupported
// configuration (spec 2.1: a hard refusal, firewall.unsupported_configuration),
// builds the change and predicts its target, whose configuration must be
// supported too. Plan and Apply both start here.
func (f fw) prepare(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, build buildFunc) (prepared, error) {
	cfg0, err := f.d.readConfig(f.d.root)
	if err != nil {
		return prepared{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: read the configured state: %w", err)
	}
	cur, err := f.d.readLoaded(ctx, env)
	if err != nil {
		return prepared{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: read the loaded state: %w", err)
	}
	if reasons := append(append([]string{}, cfg0.Unsupported...), cur.Unsupported...); len(reasons) > 0 {
		return prepared{}, errcode.New(errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration,
			"the host is an unsupported configuration: "+strings.Join(reasons, "; "))
	}
	c, err := build(cfg0, cur)
	if err != nil {
		return prepared{}, err
	}
	tg, err := f.predictTarget(cfg0, cur, c)
	if err != nil {
		return prepared{}, err
	}
	if len(tg.cfgN.Unsupported) > 0 {
		return prepared{}, errcode.New(errcode.FirewallUnsupportedConfiguration,
			"the configuration the change leads to is unsupported: "+strings.Join(tg.cfgN.Unsupported, "; "))
	}
	return prepared{cfg0: cfg0, cur: cur, c: c, tg: tg}, nil
}

// plan is the plan of every mutating firewall action (spec 2.1-2.3). After
// prepare it refuses a change of manual rules without manual: true
// (firewall.manual_required); lists every change of the logical state
// (R39) and, on a host out of sync with its configuration, each differing
// chain; reports the lockout guard; and hashes the input with the state it
// read. On an out-of-sync host the guard fails as a hard refusal, which
// overrides cannot pass, except for a repair whose difference lies in UFW's
// and Darkpanel's own chains: its guard runs on the target as usual.
// Otherwise the guard runs on the predicted loaded state with the plan's
// guard context, the apply's refresh, the retired exposures and the real
// evaluator, and a failing guard listed in overrides passes as overridden.
func (f fw) plan(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, req planReq) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	p, err := f.prepare(ctx, env, req.build)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, err
	}
	diffs, err := f.syncDiffs(p.cfg0, p.cur)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, err
	}
	from, to := logical{cfg: p.cfg0, sysctl: p.cur.Sysctl}, logical{cfg: p.tg.final, sysctl: p.tg.pred.Sysctl}
	if ids := manualChanges(from, to); len(ids) > 0 && !req.manual {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, errcode.New(errcode.FirewallManualRequired,
			fmt.Sprintf("the change removes or adds manual rules %s; set manual: true to change them", strings.Join(ids, ", ")))
	}
	out := core.PlanOutcome{Diff: stateDiff(from, to)}
	for _, d := range diffs {
		out.Diff = append(out.Diff, core.DiffLine{Op: " ", Text: "out of sync: " + chainDiffText(d)})
	}
	g, err := f.planGuard(ctx, env, req.guarded, p, diffs)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, err
	}
	out.Guards = []core.Guard{g}
	if out.StateHash, err = stateHash(req.input, p.cfg0, p.cur, env.Call.RepairOf); err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

// planGuard is the lockout guard of a plan.
func (f fw) planGuard(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, gd core.Guarded, p prepared, diffs []fwstate.ChainDiff) (core.Guard, error) {
	if len(diffs) > 0 {
		repairable := false
		if p.c.repair {
			var err error
			if repairable, err = f.confinedDiffs(p.cfg0, p.cur, diffs); err != nil {
				return core.Guard{}, err
			}
		}
		if !repairable {
			return core.Guard{ID: guard.GuardID, Message: outOfSyncMessage(diffs, p.c.repair)}, nil
		}
	}
	in := guard.Input{Plan: gd.Guard, Refresh: env.Call.GuardRefresh, Retired: env.Call.Retired, Eval: eval.Evaluate}
	g, _, err := f.check(ctx, env, p.tg.pred, in)
	if err != nil {
		return core.Guard{}, fmt.Errorf("firewall: the lockout guard: %w", err)
	}
	if !g.OK && slices.Contains(gd.Overrides, guard.GuardID) {
		g.OK, g.Overridden = true, true
	}
	return g, nil
}

// confinedDiffs reports whether the differences between the loaded state
// and the configuration's prediction lie in UFW's and Darkpanel's own
// chains.
func (f fw) confinedDiffs(cfg fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded, diffs []fwstate.ChainDiff) (bool, error) {
	tr := fwstate.TransReload
	if !cfg.Enabled {
		tr = fwstate.TransDisable
	}
	pred, err := f.d.predict(cfg, cur, tr)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("firewall: predict the loaded state of the configuration: %w", err)
	}
	return confined(diffs, pred, cur), nil
}

func outOfSyncMessage(diffs []fwstate.ChainDiff, repair bool) string {
	chains := make([]string, len(diffs))
	for i, d := range diffs {
		chains[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s/%s", d.Family, d.Table, d.Chain)
	}
	if repair {
		return "the loaded state differs from UFW's configuration outside UFW's and Darkpanel's chains (" +
			strings.Join(chains, ", ") + "), which a repair does not change; every protected flow is unknown"
	}
	return "the host is out of sync with UFW's configuration (" + strings.Join(chains, ", ") +
		"); every protected flow is unknown until firewall.state.repair brings it back"
}

// stateHash hashes what a plan depends on: the input, every file of the
// configured state, every loaded chain with its policy and rule keys, the
// sysctl values and the change a repair repairs. Apply re-plans and refuses
// when it differs (plan.state_changed).
func stateHash(input any, cfg fwstate.Config, cur fwstate.Loaded, repairOf string) (string, error) {
	doc := struct {
		Input    any               `json:"input"`
		Files    map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Variant  string            `json:"variant"`
		Loaded   []string          `json:"loaded"`
		Sysctl   map[string]string `json:"sysctl"`
		RepairOf string            `json:"repairOf,omitempty"`
	}{input, fileHashes(cfg.Files), cur.Variant, loadedKeys(cur), cur.Sysctl, repairOf}
	b, err := json.Marshal(doc)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("firewall: state hash: %w", err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

// loadedKeys lists every chain of both families with its policy, each
// followed by its rules' keys.
func loadedKeys(st fwstate.Loaded) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, f := range []struct {
		fam fwstate.Family
		rs  *netfilter.Ruleset
	}{{fwstate.V4, st.V4}, {fwstate.V6, st.V6}} {
		if f.rs == nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, t := range f.rs.Tables {
			for _, c := range t.Chains {
				out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s %s %s", f.fam, t.Name, c.Name, c.Policy))
				for _, r := range c.Rules {
					out = append(out, "  "+netfilter.Key(r, f.fam == fwstate.V6))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
package firewall

type hkInput struct {

// hkMutation adds pnRule, or runs build when it is set.
func hkMutation(f fw, build buildFunc) mutation[hkInput] {

		f:       f,

		build: func(context.Context, core.Env, hkInput) buildFunc {
			if build != nil {
				return build
			}
			return func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) {

			}
		},
		check: func(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in hkInput, _ fwstate.Config) error {
			if in.Fail {
				return errors.New("firewall: the rule is missing")
			}
			return nil
		},
		finish: func(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, _ hkInput, out *ChangeOutput) error {
			out.Rules = []string{planRuleID}
			return nil
		},
	}
}

func hkEffects(h *fakeHost) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, e := range h.journal.effects {
		out = append(out, e.Resource+" "+string(e.State))
	}
	return out
}

// TestMutationDefinition: every mutating action is revertible on the agent
// under the firewall lock, repaired by firewall.state.repair, with the
// overridable lockout guard, and the registry accepts it.
func TestMutationDefinition(t *testing.T) {
	_, f, _ := pnHost(t)
	def := defineMutation(core.ActionSpec{Name: "firewall.test.add", Summary: "Add a test rule.", Converges: true}, hkMutation(f, nil))
	repair := defineMutation(core.ActionSpec{Name: repairAction, Summary: "Repair."}, hkMutation(f, nil))
	want := core.ActionSpec{Name: "firewall.test.add", Summary: "Add a test rule.", Version: 1, Class: core.ClassRevertible,
		Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"firewall"}, Converges: true, RepairedBy: "firewall.state.repair",
		ApplyTimeout: 45 * time.Second, Guards: []core.GuardSpec{{ID: "firewall.lockout", Overridable: true}}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(def.Spec, want) {
		t.Errorf("spec %+v, want %+v", def.Spec, want)
	}
	if def.Handler.Observe == nil || def.Handler.Snapshot == nil || def.Handler.Revert == nil {
		t.Error("the handler lacks Observe, Snapshot or Revert")
	}
	if _, err := core.NewRegistry(fwTestModule{defs: []core.ActionDef{def, repair}}); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("core.NewRegistry: %v", err)
	}
}

// fwTestModule is a firewall module holding only the given actions.
type fwTestModule struct{ defs []core.ActionDef }

func (m fwTestModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	return core.Manifest{ID: ID, Version: 1, Actions: m.defs, DefaultEnabled: true}
}

// TestMutationLifecycle: snapshot, apply as journaled effects with the
// reload of an active UFW, post-apply hashes, the action's output, verify,
// and a revert that restores the snapshot whole.
func TestMutationLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, _ := pnHost(t)
	m := hkMutation(f, nil)
	gc := &core.GuardContext{Complete: true}
	in := hkInput{Guarded: core.Guarded{Guard: gc}}
	env := h.env()

	raw, err := m.Snapshot(ctx, env, in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snap, err := getSnapshot(ctx, h.db, string(raw))
	if err != nil || snap.State.Guard == nil || !snap.State.Guard.Complete || snap.State.Image != nil {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot %+v (%v), want the plan's guard context and no before-image", snap.State, err)
	}
	before := h.state()
	out, err := m.Apply(ctx, env, in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if out.Snapshot != string(raw) || !reflect.DeepEqual(out.Rules, []string{planRuleID}) {
		t.Errorf("output %+v, want the snapshot and the finish's fields", out)
	}
	if got, want := hkEffects(h), []string{"firewall.rule:" + planRuleID + " made", "firewall.state:enabled made"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("effects %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(h.calls[len(h.calls)-1], "/usr/sbin/ufw reload") {
		t.Errorf("calls %v, want a reload last", h.calls)
	}
	if snap, _ = getSnapshot(ctx, h.db, string(raw)); snap.ChangeID != "c1" || snap.PostHashes == nil {
		t.Errorf("snapshot change %q post hashes %v, want attached with post hashes", snap.ChangeID, snap.PostHashes)
	}
	if err := m.Verify(ctx, env, in, out); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Verify: %v", err)
	}
	rev, err := m.Revert(ctx, env, raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rev.Effects) != 2 || rev.Effects[0].State != core.EffectUndone || rev.Effects[1].State != core.EffectUndone || rev.Override {
		t.Errorf("revert %+v, want both effects undone", rev)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(h.state(), before) {
		t.Errorf("state after revert %+v, want %+v", h.state(), before)
	}
	obs, err := m.Observe(ctx, env, h.journal.effects[0])
	if err != nil || string(obs.Current.State) != "null" {
		t.Errorf("Observe = %s, %v; want the rule absent", obs.Current.State, err)
	}
}

// TestMutationVerify: the action's own check fails verify first; then a
// loaded state that differs from the prediction is a prediction mismatch.
func TestMutationVerify(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, _ := pnHost(t)
	m := hkMutation(f, nil)
	if err := m.Verify(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{Fail: true}, ChangeOutput{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "missing") {
		t.Errorf("Verify = %v, want the action's check", err)
	}
	h.diffs = []fwstate.ChainDiff{{Family: fwstate.V6, Table: "filter", Chain: "ufw6-user-input", OnlyA: []string{"-j ACCEPT"}}}
	err := m.Verify(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{}, ChangeOutput{})
	if e := errcode.From(err); e.Code != errcode.FirewallPredictionMismatch || !strings.Contains(e.Detail, "v6 filter/ufw6-user-input") {
		t.Errorf("Verify = %v, want a prediction mismatch naming the chain", err)
	}
}

// TestMutationPlanAndFailure: Plan is the shared pipeline with the input's
// guard and manual flag; a ufw failure fails Apply and leaves its effect
// for the engine.
func TestMutationPlanAndFailure(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, stub := pnHost(t)
	m := hkMutation(f, nil)
	stub.guard = core.Guard{OK: false, Message: "the change would cut ssh"}
	out, err := m.Plan(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{Guarded: core.Guarded{Overrides: []string{guard.GuardID}}})
	if err != nil || !out.Guards[0].Overridden || len(out.Diff) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("plan %+v (%v), want the change with the guard overridden", out, err)
	}
	h.ufw[strings.Join(model.AddArgs(pnRule), " ")] = func(*fhState) int { return 1 }
	if _, err := m.Snapshot(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := m.Apply(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "exited 1") {
		t.Errorf("Apply = %v, want ufw's failure", err)
	}
	if got := hkEffects(h); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"firewall.rule:?" + planRuleID + " skipped"}) {
		t.Errorf("effects %v, want the rule skipped", got)
	}
}

// TestMutationRestore: a restore writes each differing file once (ufw.conf
// with the current ENABLED while the state changes), then the transition,
// then each differing sysctl value of an interface that still exists.
func TestMutationRestore(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h, f, _ := pnHost(t)
	h.ufw["--force enable"] = func(s *fhState) int { s.Enabled = true; return 0 }
	h.ufw["disable"] = func(s *fhState) int { s.Enabled = false; return 0 }
	h.loaded = fwstate.Loaded{Variant: "nft", V4: fhParse(t, tgStopped), V6: fhParse(t, tgStopped)}

	cfg := h.config()
	var entries []core.RestoreEntry
	for _, p := range fwstate.StateFiles {
		entries = append(entries, cfg.Files[p])
	}
	snap := snapshot{ID: "01J00000000000000000000008", Entries: entries, State: snapshotState{Enabled: true,
		Sysctl: map[string]string{"net/ipv4/ip_forward": "1", "net/ipv4/conf/eth0/rp_filter": "1", "net/ipv4/conf/eth7/rp_filter": "0"}}}
	s := h.state()
	s.Enabled, s.Rules4 = false, s.Rules4[:1]
	h.setState(s)

	m := hkMutation(f, func(fwstate.Config, fwstate.Loaded) (change, error) { return change{restore: &snap}, nil })
	if _, err := m.Snapshot(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := m.Apply(ctx, h.env(), hkInput{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"firewall.file:/etc/ufw/user.rules made", "firewall.state:enabled made", "firewall.sysctl:net/ipv4/ip_forward made"}
	if got := hkEffects(h); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("effects %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	var enabled bool
	if err := json.Unmarshal(h.journal.effects[1].Before.State, &enabled); err != nil || enabled {
		t.Errorf("the enable's before-state is %s, want UFW disabled", h.journal.effects[1].Before.State)
	}
	if got := h.state(); !got.Enabled || len(got.Rules4) != 2 || h.sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"] != "1" {
		t.Errorf("state %+v, ip_forward %s; want the snapshot's", got, h.sysctl["net/ipv4/ip_forward"])
	}
}
```
